description: This file defines the ConfigState struct and associated methods for configuring and formatting output in the 'spew' package, including dumping, stringifying, and custom formatters.

classes.name: ConfigState
classes.description: Houses configuration options for formatting and displaying values in the 'spew' package.

methods.name: Errorf
methods.description: Wraps fmt.Errorf, formatting arguments with custom spew formatters.

methods.name: Fprint
methods.description: Wraps fmt.Fprint, printing arguments with custom spew formatters.

methods.name: Fprintf
methods.description: Wraps fmt.Fprintf, formatting and printing arguments with custom spew formatters.

methods.name: Fprintln
methods.description: Wraps fmt.Fprintln, printing arguments with custom spew formatters.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Wraps fmt.Print, printing arguments with custom spew formatters.

methods.name: Printf
methods.description: Wraps fmt.Printf, formatting and printing arguments with custom spew formatters.

methods.name: Println
methods.description: Wraps fmt.Println, printing arguments with custom spew formatters.

methods.name: Sprint
methods.description: Wraps fmt.Sprint, returning a string with arguments formatted with custom spew formatters.

methods.name: Sprintf
methods.description: Wraps fmt.Sprintf, returning a formatted string with arguments processed by custom spew formatters.

methods.name: Sprintln
methods.description: Wraps fmt.Sprintln, returning a string with arguments formatted with custom spew formatters.

methods.name: NewFormatter
methods.description: Returns a custom formatter satisfying fmt.Formatter for inline printing.

methods.name: Fdump
methods.description: Formats and displays arguments to an io.Writer, same as Dump.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Displays parameters to stdout with detailed formatting, handling pointers, circular structures, and custom interfaces.

methods.name: Sdump
methods.description: Returns a string with formatted parameters, same as Dump.

methods.name: convertArgs
methods.description: Converts a slice of arguments into a slice of formatters using the current ConfigState.

methods.name: NewDefaultConfig
methods.description: Returns a ConfigState with default settings for indentation and other options.
